case_title: Subhash Krishnan v. State of Goa
aggravating_circumstances: Use of weapons, infliction of severe injuries, abduction, wrongful confinement, hanging to death
trial_court_outcome: Acquitted some accused; convicted others of murder and related offences
high_court_outcome: Partly allowed cross-appeal; convicted A-1 to A-4 of all offences including Sections 342 and 364 read with Section 34
offence_finally_established: Murder under Section 302, IPC, read with Section 34, IPC
neutral_facts: The prosecution case was that the deceased, along with PW-2 and another person, went to meet A-1 to settle a dispute related to a love affair. The accused assaulted the deceased with a knife, sword, and bamboo stick, and then A-2 (the appellant) brought a Maruti van to transport the deceased. The van was intercepted by the police, and the deceased's body was later found hanging from a tree. The deceased had 36 injuries, some caused by a talwar, knife, and danda. The accused were identified by multiple witnesses, including PW-21, PW-25, and others, who testified to the appellant's involvement in the assault. The trial court acquitted some accused, but the High Court convicted A-1 to A-4 of all charges, including abduction, wrongful confinement, and murder.
